reviews.rationale: Sequential GAAP comparison of selected SEC exhibit rows shows revenue, operating income, attributable net income and diluted EPS all higher in the later quarter, with the operating subtotal rising alongside the revenue line and the bottom-line subtotals. Because the extract cannot support a stronger or weaker conviction, conviction is unchanged and the review is recorded as a maintain with the thesis remaining actionable; a fuller filing review, year-over-year comparatives and company-defined measures would be needed to change that view.
